rows.description: A young child confirms with yes, okay or a nod and accepts a rule when it is clear and fair. Reasons given calmly help a child accept limits rather than merely obey.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A preschooler denies a mistake with no, I did not or rejects food or clothes. It may be fear of getting in trouble, so calm adults separate the child from the mistake.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A preschooler learns polite asking with please and thank you, though whining and demanding still appear when frustrated. Adults respond best to the polite form and gently coach the rest.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A young child pleads or begs with a wobbling voice, showing strong wants or fear. Consistent calm limits teach that pleading does not change a firm decision.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child hears watch out or careful as a signal to stop and look. Adults keep warnings for real danger so the words keep their power.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A preschooler follows short one-step instructions and needs reminders that are calm and repeated. Long lists or a scolding tone reduce cooperation, so a child benefits from being shown as well.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A young child learns that allowed and forbidden depend on the person, place and safety, such as yes to a hug from a parent and no to a stranger. Simple clear rules and explaining why help.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: affection, anger, trust

rows.description: A preschooler learns to say stop, I do not like that, and to tell a trusted adult if someone will not stop. Adults respond calmly and take every such report seriously.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A preschooler promises I will be good with sincere intention but limited ability to keep it. Adults treat the promise as a hope and help the child plan how to keep it.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A young child volunteers with me, I can help, wanting to feel capable and included. Giving small real tasks builds a sense of responsibility.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
